goal: Inspect routes.json in this project. Generate a dependency-free Node plugin that parses the actual JSON routes on every input, with original evidence and stable route IDs. Handle future additions and deletions from current snapshots, never output a fixed list. Use repo default scope. Include non-empty acceptance cases and fixtures exported from Core (stageId must match the manifest). Verify and activate it. Only support the confirmed JSON format and report gaps for anything else.

investigation.notes:
Route registry convention (confirmed by reading the Core-exported source, not by directory naming).

1) Registry file: `routes.json` at repository root; repositoryId `repo.main`; indexed file entity `ent_647366ea7d0bc26ecc2db20f483b799d1647a10a6ffb351d7c488a5b5a4bd3d8`; scopeId `repo.repo.main`; sourceClass `config`; 124 bytes; CRLF terminator; contentHash `ed7c08383e568fcdcbbe6daae45d60f4cc8c9534d04ba85e3524bcb292a3f102`; sourceId `src_b2dd364bf4438e6e3826e795629e5d8693507bb127b52cde0afbbdf8ca98ffce`; read-source status `current`, lineMap lineStarts [0,124].
   Observed text: `{"routerId":"app","mode":"history","routes":[{"path":"/orders","name":"Orders"},{"path":"/inventory","name":"Inventory"}]}`

2) Confirmed shape (basis: observed): top-level object with `routerId` (string, `app`), `mode` (string, `history`), `routes` (array). Every element is an object with `path` (string beginning with `/`) and `name` (string label). No component/import/target/children/metadata observed.

3) Route identity (basis: declared in the Core template identity spec, ENTITY_COMPONENTS.route): canonical slot order `scopeId`, `routerId`, `mode`, `declaredPath`. Therefore the stable route ID depends only on scope + routerId + mode + declaredPath; `name` is a title/attribute only, so renaming a route must not change its identity.

4) Default scope (basis: inferred from a single repository): repo default scope `repo.repo.main`, from Core status coverage key `routes@repo.repo.main` / sourceSetId `repo.main`; observed pattern is `repo.` + repositoryId, so the plugin computes it from each source's repositoryId at run time instead of hard-coding it.

5) Evidence anchoring (basis: observed): `routes` array spans bytes 44..122; the `/orders` object spans 45..79; the `/inventory` object spans 80..120; registry object spans 0..122. These are reproducible by byte-level scanning of the registry text (string- and escape-aware), so every run emits original evidence for the current snapshot rather than copied positions.

6) Coverage limits — must be reported as gaps, never guessed: only the `routes.json` JSON registry format above is supported. Route definitions in JS/TS/JSX/Vue/React-Router code, menu tables, YAML/TOML, or any other JSON shape are unsupported. The registry binds no view/component/operation/data-table target, so cross-layer relations are not derivable and must be surfaced as an unresolved-binding gap. No i18n/title source is referenced; `name` is used only as the assertion name.
